description: Implementation of a video decoder class using the libde265 library for H.265/HEVC decoding, managing decoding process, threading, error handling, and decode target updates.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class that manages H.265 video decoding using libde265, including thread management, error handling, and output frame management.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoder with specified codec, output mode, and graphics context provider.

methods.name: ~VideoDecoder
methods.description: Destructor that resets the decoder state.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with callback functions for status and error reporting.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream, flushing remaining frames.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, cancels pending jobs, and clears frames.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Updates the decode target with the current frame, locking mutex.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Creates and starts worker threads for decoding.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Frees decoder resources and releases decode targets.

methods.name: DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Processes a single input buffer, decoding it.

methods.name: DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Flushes decoder to process remaining data at stream end.

methods.name: ProcessDecodedImage
methods.description: Decodes available images, creates video frames, and manages callbacks.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decoded frame as a decode target for rendering.
